Epoch leader schedule management across two epochs, with slot and leader lookup.

# Purpose
`fd_multi_epoch_leaders.c` implements the management layer for a small set of epoch leader schedules stored in shared memory. It provides the life-cycle functions [`fd_multi_epoch_leaders_new`](<#fd_multi_epoch_leaders_new>), [`fd_multi_epoch_leaders_join`](<#fd_multi_epoch_leaders_join>), [`fd_multi_epoch_leaders_leave`](<#fd_multi_epoch_leaders_leave>), and [`fd_multi_epoch_leaders_delete`](<#fd_multi_epoch_leaders_delete>), plus alignment and null checks for the shared-memory object. During initialization, it creates one `fd_epoch_leaders_t` schedule for each epoch slot in `MULTI_EPOCH_LEADERS_EPOCH_CNT`, stores them in `leaders->lsched`, and tracks which entries are ready with `init_done`.

The file also provides query and update functions for leader lookup across epochs and slots. [`fd_multi_epoch_leaders_get_lsched_for_epoch`](<#fd_multi_epoch_leaders_get_lsched_for_epoch>), [`fd_multi_epoch_leaders_get_lsched_for_slot`](<#fd_multi_epoch_leaders_get_lsched_for_slot>), [`fd_multi_epoch_leaders_get_leader_for_slot`](<#fd_multi_epoch_leaders_get_leader_for_slot>), and [`fd_multi_epoch_leaders_get_next_slot`](<#fd_multi_epoch_leaders_get_next_slot>) search the active schedules to find the correct epoch or leader for a given slot or public key. The functions [`fd_multi_epoch_leaders_stake_msg_init`](<#fd_multi_epoch_leaders_stake_msg_init>) and [`fd_multi_epoch_leaders_stake_msg_fini`](<#fd_multi_epoch_leaders_stake_msg_fini>) copy stake-weight data from an incoming `fd_stake_weight_msg_t`, rebuild the affected epoch schedule, and mark it as initialized. [`fd_multi_epoch_leaders_get_sorted_lscheds`](<#fd_multi_epoch_leaders_get_sorted_lscheds>) returns the active schedules in epoch order for callers that need a stable view of the current set.
